subject: Medico.ai RFP — request for evaluation stipend and schedule
messages:
From: Emily Hart <emily.hart@medico.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medico.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP bake-off — request for eval credits and timing

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the cost controls in Redwood Optimize. We're running a tight bake-off next month vs two incumbents and I wanted to confirm whether Redwood can provide an evaluation stipend and a short trial extension to support our benchmark.

Scope:
- 2-week pilot, ~1.2M tokens total (inference + eval instrumentation)
- 3x concurrent worker processes, typical sequence lengths ~1.5k tokens
- Need access to streaming responses + rolling logs for scoring

Ask:
1) A credits allotment for the pilot (estimate 80k–120k credits depending on token conversion)
2) Trial extension of 30 days from start date (we're targeting Jun 3 start)
3) A brief mutual action plan so we can align engineering and security contacts

Attached our RFP spec and a short slide describing the scoring rubric. Can you let me know what you can commit to by EOD tomorrow? We're consolidating sponsorships and will include any credit commitments in the vendor rubric.

Best,
Emily
Emily Hart
Head of Data Platforms, Medico.ai
[Attachment: medico-RFP-specs.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 92KB)]

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Hart <emily.hart@medico.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — request for eval credits and timing

Hi Emily — great to hear the demo landed well. Thanks for sharing the spec.

Short answer: we can support the bake-off and are open to structuring a pilot stipend + a 30-day extension, but I need to loop in Marissa for approval on the credit amount and Karthik for the T&Cs (contract/usage limits/security).

Proposed initial package (subject to approvals):
- $10k worth of credits (convertible to ~100k tokens under the standard trial conversion)
- 30-day trial extension starting on the pilot kickoff date (no automatic renew)
- Access to streaming response endpoints and per-token logging for the evaluation window

Next steps I suggest:
1) I'll draft a mutual action plan (MAP) with dates and success criteria and share the MAP and a short SOC2 summary.
2) Marissa — can you confirm whether we should offer additional top-up credits on a discretionary basis if Medico uploads more test data or extends the pilot?
3) Karthik — please flag any security/contract conditions we should surface to Emily.

I'll attach the MAP for your review (v1) and copy the relevant attachments for compliance.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa and Karthik.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bakeoff-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 128KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — request for eval credits and timing

Thanks Aditya — flagging budget constraints and approval path.

Context for approval:
- Medico.ai is a mid-market health-tech prospect with clear upside; pilot could materially expand into a Dedicated contract if they select Redwood.
- Standard discretionary pilot stipend is $5k for late-stage evaluation; larger amounts require Sales Ops + RevOps signoff or manager approval.

Proposal:
- Approve $10k in credits as a one-time, manager-approved exception given the health vertical and potential deal size. Condition it on: completion of our security questionnaire and an internal SLA around usage capping (we add a hard token cap and notify on 80% usage).
- No ongoing extension beyond the 30 days unless we see strong engagement metrics (latency SLOs met, score delta > 10% vs. next best).

Karthik — please draft a short terms addendum capturing the usage cap, requirement to complete the SOC2 checklist, and the 30-day extension window. Once you provide the addendum I'll sign off and issue the credit.

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Hart <emily.hart@medico.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2029 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — request for eval credits and timing

Marissa / Aditya / Emily —

Thanks for the details. I've drafted a brief addendum capturing the approved exceptions and the operational guardrails. Key points:
- One-time credit allocation: $10,000 (applied as trial balance to account DEAL-4492)
- Trial extension: 30 days from kickoff date (must be flagged in our billing system at start)
- Usage guardrails: hard token cap equivalent set to $12k to allow small overage for load testing; automatic notification at 80% consumption; account locked for further generation if cap is exceeded until review
- Security precondition: completion of our minimal SOC2 questionnaire and acceptance of the data handling annex (attached)

Emily — please review the attached addendum and SOC2-summary. If acceptable we'll route the DocuSign PowerForm (link below) for signature and start the credit issuance once we receive the signed addendum and questionnaire.

DocuSign (PowerForm): https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4492

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, addendum-DEAL-4492.pdf (stubs attached to this thread).

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (application/pdf, 45KB)]

From: Emily Hart <emily.hart@medico.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2029 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — request for eval credits and timing

Karthik / Marissa / Aditya —

Thanks — that works for us. We'll complete the SOC2 checklist by EOD tomorrow and sign the DocuSign PowerForm. A quick clarification: will the hard cap be enforced by token counts or dollar burn? We have internal tooling that reports token usage but prefer a dollar-equivalent cap so we can include pre-procured model weights in the budget.

Next steps for scheduling:
- We aim to start the pilot on Mon, Jun 3; 2-week run with nightly scoring.
- I'll upload the data and baseline test harness to the shared bucket and invite your engineers.

Once DocuSign is complete, please share the MAP with kickoff dates and the Redwood contact for infra access. Looking forward to the run.

—Emily
Emily Hart
Head of Data Platforms, Medico.ai
[Attachment: confirmation-of-schedule.txt (text/plain, 1KB)]
